# Bundled layout component

`dagre-3.1.3.js` is the unmodified browser bundle `dist/dagre.min.js`
from `@dagrejs/dagre@3.1.3`, loaded in a local Node.js VM context. It includes graphlib.
Source: https://github.com/dagrejs/dagre
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/@dagrejs/dagre/-/dagre-3.1.3.tgz
Package SHA-512 (base64): `X4aUTwOReZvthaZWOVHqlJ52/ZdhZFEM4+Lh/uR4XooUSLE6p71bcy7MPGzYnNUcNh+nj+i/qJQpCMIdQnSmrg==`

MIT notices are preserved in `DAGRE-LICENSE.txt` and
`dagre.min.js.LEGAL.txt`. These components are not covered by Gin's
proprietary license. Only generated geometry is placed in business HTML;
the layout library runs locally during generation and is not needed to
view the output.
